protocol: Digit OCR (tesseract, psm 7, digit whitelist, 3x upscale) on the fixed coin-free crop (610,586,640,610). The script never opens the master; the master is compared after OCR. The crop was chosen after seeing the sample of ten, so the sample figure is tuned. The out-of-sample figure is the planning-frame run over the other rounds.

gold.note: sample of ten, tuned crop; the one miss is 5-5, a one-second offset

streak.note: sample of ten; 6-2 OCR empty, frame shows 1, master 1

level.note: crop (188,588,206,606) calibrated on the out-of-sample frame at 2-3, 604 s (level 4) before the sample run

xp.note: crop (244,588,274,606), whitelist digits and slash; same calibration frame

gold_masked_near_white.note: near-white mask (min RGB > 200), 4x nearest upscale, digit whitelist psm 7; several frames gave no digits, so the 71/57/9 two-digit golds are cut or unreadable in this crop. Not an improvement over the unmasked 4/10.

time_check.result: all 10 blind-pick times equal the Frame A times

gold_original_crop.note: coin and neighbouring digits leak in

miss.6-2: OCR returned empty; frame at 2342 s shows 1, master 1 confirmed

gold_planning_frames.in_sample_miss: 5-5 at 2094 s (timer 22, gold 9); the planning entry is timer 21 at 2095 s (gold 7), which matches

gold_frame_a_run.note: Earlier run at Frame A times; superseded by the planning-frame run above

level_xp_protocol: Calibration on one out-of-sample frame (2-3 at 604 s) before the sample run; the ten sample rounds read at their planning frames.
script: data/hud-audit/blind_ocr_planning.py (planning-frame OCR for gold, streak, level and XP; the sample rounds are fixed in the script)
